## SEPSIS WITH SUSPECTED SEVERE CLOSTRIDIUM DIFFICILE INFECTION
Consider empirical broad-spectrum antimicrobials and consulting Infectious
Diseases if Clostridium difficile is not strongly suspected as the main source
of infection. Refer to Unclear Infectious Source for recommendations.
Unclear Infectious Source
## If No ileus:
Metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h <AND> vancomycin 500 mg PO q6h
**ONLY for Vancomycin NG administration**
Metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h <AND> vancomycin 500 mg NG q6h
## If ileus:
Metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h <AND> vancomycin 500 mg PO q6h
<AND> vancomycin enema 500 mg in 100 ml normal saline q6h
**ONLY for Vancomycin NG administration**
Metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h <AND> vancomycin 500 mg NG soln q6h
<AND> vancomycin enema 500 mg in 100 ml normal saline q6h
